title: Benchmarks
subtitle: For each kind of job: the best model, the best model for the money, and the cheapest one that is still decent. Quality comes from public blind-vote leaderboards; prices are what a default run costs with your keys.

picks.bestValueHint: Most quality above the floor per dollar.
picks.cheapestDecentHint: Lowest price among models within {gap} Elo of the leader.
picks.editorsPickHint: Openstudio's own choice, independent of the scores.

unscoredTitle: No public leaderboard lists this model, so it is not ranked.
noPriceTitle: The provider quotes this model per unit, not per run, so it has no value score.
needsKeyTitle: None of your keyed providers serves this model and it has no published list price. Available on {providers}.
listPriceTitle: No key for a provider that serves this model; this is {provider}'s published list price.
perCharacters: Speech is priced on a {count}-character sample.
svgPrompt: Code-written SVG is priced on a {count}-character prompt, one SVG per run; Rapidata's Elo scale is stretched about 2.3× compared with the other boards, so the same gaps are stricter cuts here.
noneHint: No model in this category has both a score and a price. Add a provider key to see prices.
empty: No models in this category are served by a supported provider.
decentNote: Decent means within {gap} Elo of the leader ({floor} or more). Value counts only quality above {valueFloor} Elo ({valueGap} below the leader) and divides it by the price of one default run.
